title: Inventory internal new body layouts and obsolete current
summary: Four inventory reports receive new WordBody layouts with cleaner internal designs while their existing Word layouts are marked obsolete, with no change to default behavior for end users.
key_points: New WordBody layouts added to Inventory Order Details, Customer Sales, Vendor Purchases, and Sales Back Orders reports
Existing Word layouts marked ObsoleteState Pending with tag 30.0 to give partners time to migrate
Default rendering layout unchanged, so current users experience no behavior change
Hardcoded labels replaced with translatable labels in new layouts
quote: all reports run with default theme and header footer design internal
